LESSON: PLACES OF WORSHIP

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Worship (Ishwar Bhakti)
Topic 4.2: Places of Worship

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Places of Worship. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: What is the importance of features you see while visiting a Sikh Gurdwara?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. describe the locations of Jain Derasar and Sikh Gurdwara (temples) in Kenya
2. classify the practices and ceremonies held in Jain Derasar and Sikh Gurdwara
3. appreciate ceremonies held in Jain Derasar and Sikh Gurdwara

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: PLACES OF WORSHIP
Subject: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION · Grade: Grade 5
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Places of Worship helps you succeed in HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

KEY FACTS: PLACES OF WORSHIP
Study Places of Worship like a learner textbook page: meaning → examples → practice → check.
Replace teacher words with your own words.
If a step is unclear, rewrite it shorter and try again.

PART 1: Describe the locations of Jain Derasar and Sikh Gurdwara (temples) in Kenya

What this means
In this part you learn to describe the locations of Jain Derasar and Sikh Gurdwara (temples) in Kenya. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: describe the locations of Jain Derasar and Sikh Gurdwara (temples) in Kenya.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Value in action: Show how “Places of Worship” looks when you treat a classmate kindly.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can describe the locations of Jain Derasar and Sikh Gurdwara (temples) in Kenya. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 2: Classify the practices and ceremonies held in Jain Derasar and Sikh Gurdwara

What this means
In this part you learn to classify the practices and ceremonies held in Jain Derasar and Sikh Gurdwara. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: classify the practices and ceremonies held in Jain Derasar and Sikh Gurdwara.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Story link: Retell a short faith/values story connected to Places of Worship in your own words.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can classify the practices and ceremonies held in Jain Derasar and Sikh Gurdwara. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 3: Appreciate ceremonies held in Jain Derasar and Sikh Gurdwara

What this means
In this part you learn to appreciate ceremonies held in Jain Derasar and Sikh Gurdwara. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: appreciate ceremonies held in Jain Derasar and Sikh Gurdwara.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Daily habit: Choose one good action to practise today because of this lesson.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can appreciate ceremonies held in Jain Derasar and Sikh Gurdwara. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Places of Worship is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Show how “Places of Worship” looks when you treat a classmate kindly. (skill: describe the locations of Jain Derasar and Sikh Gurdwara (temples) in Kenya)

Example 2: Retell a short faith/values story connected to Places of Worship in your own words. (skill: classify the practices and ceremonies held in Jain Derasar and Sikh Gurdwara)

Example 3: Choose one good action to practise today because of this lesson. (skill: appreciate ceremonies held in Jain Derasar and Sikh Gurdwara)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Places of Worship to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: describe the locations of Jain Derasar and Sikh Gurdwara (temples) in Kenya.
3. Practise this skill: classify the practices and ceremonies held in Jain Derasar and Sikh Gurdwara.
4. Practise this skill: appreciate ceremonies held in Jain Derasar and Sikh Gurdwara.
5. Make one local Kenya example of Places of Worship from your county, market, farm, or school.
6. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Places of Worship: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 5 learner study Places of Worship?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. What is the importance of features you see while visiting a Sikh Gurdwara?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Places of Worship means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: describe the locations of Jain Derasar and Sikh Gurdwara (temples) in Kenya.
5. Be able to: classify the practices and ceremonies held in Jain Derasar and Sikh Gurdwara.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
